UPNM, which stands for Universiti Pertahanan Nasional Malaysia (National Defense University of Malaysia), is the country's premier military university situated at Kem Sungai Besi in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Established to support the needs of the Malaysian Armed Forces, UPNM uniquely integrates rigorous academic education with specialized military training. The institution caters to a dual student body consisting of Cadet Officers, who undergo full-time training to be commissioned into the Army, Navy or Air Force upon graduation and civilian students who pursue standard academic degrees. While maintaining a core focus on national security, defense technologies, and strategic management, the university offers a comprehensive array of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines including medicine, engineering, management and cyber security with the ultimate goal of producing highly disciplined, intellectual leaders for both military and civilian sectors.

The airline also contributes to the growth of tourism and the strengthening of Uzbekistan’s international cooperation.
